_comment: Single source of truth for agent file ownership in the TRIALFORGE SDK. Paths are globs relative to the SDK root (skeleton/). Every SDK file is owned by exactly one agent. It lives outside agents/ because Kiro reads every agents/*.json as an agent. The agent JSON files in skeleton/.kiro/agents and the repository-root .kiro/agents are generated from this file by scripts/sync_kiro_config.py in the repository root (one level above skeleton/); edit this file, then run that script.

contracts-owner.description: Sole owner of shared models, public adapter contracts, errors, the public API and the architecture rules
contracts-owner.duties: Make only additive, backward-compatible changes to shared types; deprecate before removing. Update tests/public_api_snapshot.txt for additions and bump versions per .kiro/steering/public-api-stability.md. You are the only agent that may change a shared type: when another agent sends a contract-change request, implement it (or reject it with a reason), then tell the requester which names to import.

statistics-owner.description: Owner of the statistical engine, outcome evaluation, reporting and their independent verification
statistics-owner.duties: Follow .kiro/steering/statistical-correctness.md. Every new statistic needs a test against an independent reference (scipy, statsmodels, closed form or simulation). Never pool treatments; never report inference the data cannot support.

execution-owner.description: Owner of the execution lifecycle, recovery, persistence, history and events
execution-owner.duties: Persist state before acting, commit runs and measurements atomically, never silently complete or duplicate interrupted runs. Add crash/restart tests against a file database for every recovery change, and mutation-check concurrency tests.

designer-measurements-owner.description: Owner of experiment designs, the measurement engine and expression utilities
designer-measurements-owner.duties: Designs report their real properties (aliasing, resolution, run counts) computed, not looked up. Raw measurements are never mutated; every conversion or quality flag is recorded. Expression utilities stay free of eval/exec.

optimisation-owner.description: Owner of the optimiser (Gaussian process + expected improvement, constraints, stopping)
optimisation-owner.duties: Use trialforge.evaluation for feasibility and outcomes; never reimplement it. Proposals are labelled with the method that produced them (model-based vs heuristic). Tests check behaviour against Monte Carlo or closed forms, not just that code runs.

examples-docs-owner.description: Owner of the example adapters, documentation, developer scripts and the adapter contract suite
examples-docs-owner.duties: Examples use only `from trialforge import ...` and label synthetic data (.kiro/steering/domain-independence.md). Docs snippets marked `# docs-test` must run. Regenerate docs/api_reference/index.md with scripts/gen_api_reference.py instead of editing it.
